author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: gclk_b = clk_b & en_a_q with en_a_q launched in asynchronous clk_a: CDC-020 ERROR Established. CDC-045(a) also warns on the latch-less gate, but h17 shows it fires for a same-domain enable, so it does not establish the seeded cross-domain enable defect; Reader A's CDC-045 addition rejected. Reader A's gclk_b-constraint note leaves the label unchanged.

author_reading.rationale: clk_b is gated directly by en_a_q, a register launched in asynchronous clk_a.

labels.rationale: An asynchronous clk_a flop drives a raw AND gate on clk_b. A high-phase enable transition can add an edge or shorten a pulse. The gate has no low-phase latch.
labels.suspected_flaw: The SDC times data and output to clk_b without a reviewed relationship for gclk_b.

labels.rationale: Clock gclk_b is formed by combinational AND gating of clk_b with en_a_q (assign gclk_b = clk_b & en_a_q at design.sv:15), where en_a_q is launched by asynchronous clock clk_a (design.sv:13), causing asynchronous clock-gate glitches and metastability on gclk_b (CDC-020 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: gclk_b = clk_b & en_a_q with en_a_q launched in asynchronous clk_a: CDC-020 ERROR Established. CDC-045(a) also warns on the latch-less gate, but h17 shows it fires for a same-domain enable, so it does not establish the seeded cross-domain enable defect; Reader A's CDC-045 addition rejected. Reader A's gclk_b-constraint note leaves the label unchanged.
